title: When George Lucas
description: WHEN GEORGE LUCAS decided that Jedi don't seek revenge, this teaser poster (front) became an overnight collectible. The art direction and design was by Bill Pate. photographic special effects by Ron Sato, and retouch illustration by Drew Struzan. While the first poster for RETURN OF THE JEDI simply showed a pair of hands holding a lightsaber, Kazuhiko Sano illustrated more of the film's overall elements in the follow-up theatrical poster (back).
